module: Procedural generator of gymkhana-style courses, used by track generation scenarios. From starting rectangles (params.startingRects), it splits the area with util/rectangleGen to get a graph of key points, searches for a random path through them (depth-first search with backtracking), turns it into a winding track (turns, loops, straight lines), then creates in the level, under a "GymkhanaArena" SimGroup, the road (DecalRoad), cones, gates, concrete rings, barrels and BeamNGWaypoint waypoints for the current scenario. A seed makes the track reproducible; it can also be expressed as words (intToWords/wordsToInt). The objects use models from the driver_training level.
usage:
local p = extensions.util_procTrack.getDefaultParams()
p.populateFunction = function(params, scenarioParam) --[[ fill params.startingRects ]] end
p.decoration.afterFunction = function(scenarioParam) end
extensions.util_procTrack.makeGymkhana(p)
notes: The caller must provide params.populateFunction(params, scenarionParam) (which fills params.startingRects, rootX/rootY/rootZ, etc.) and params.decoration.afterFunction(scenarionParam); the field name is spelled "scenarionParam" (typo kept from the code).

Default parameters: root area (rootX, rootY, rootZ, rootAngleRad), attempt limits (nodeCreationCounter 5, pathCounter 15), rectModeParams (minXDist/minYDist 15 m, minNodes 6, maxNodes 27, density 0.85 per 1000 m2, fixNodes), path (minRadius 2.5, pylonRadiusThreshold 6, loop and gate probabilities, closed, lapCount), decoration (gateHeight 3, gateWidth 4.5).

The number of nodes is (number of noSplit rectangles) + area / (1000 / density) + a random value between randomMin and randomMax, clamped between minNodes and maxNodes. Beyond 27 generation can become extremely long (code comment).
The path search is a depth-first search with backtracking on a Hamiltonian path problem (NP-complete): the worst case is very costly.
The seed is an integer: without a seed, it is drawn with os.time then math.random. math.randomseed(params.seed) is called in checkParams.

Generation modifies the level (creation of SimGroup, DecalRoad, TSStatic, waypoints, be:reloadCollision()) and the current scenario (scenario.nodes, scenario.lapConfig); it deletes the old GymkhanaArena group.
With debug.neighbours = true (default value) white debug roads connect neighboring nodes; debug.rects is also true by default.
makeBarrel concatenates skin with no default value: a nil skin would cause a Lua error.
The local coordinates (x, y, z) passed to getPosition are rotated by rootAngleRad then offset by rootX/rootY/rootZ.

getDefaultParams.desc: Returns a new table of default parameters for a gymkhana (see notes).

reGenerate.desc: Regenerates the whole track reusing populateFunction, scenarionParam and afterFunction from the current parameters, with the given seed. makeGymkhana must have been called before.

seed.desc: New seed (nil: a random seed is drawn)

makeGymkhana.desc: Main function: validates the parameters, generates the points, the path, the road, the cones/gates, the scenario waypoints, then calls decoration.afterFunction and displays a message with the seed.

checkParams.desc: Checks and completes the parameters: sets the seed, calls populateFunction, computes the density and the target number of nodes (clamped by minNodes and maxNodes) and loads util/rectangleGen.

makeBaseNodePositions.desc: Generates the graph of key points (via rectangleGen.getGraph) and, if debug.neighbours is true, draws debug roads between neighbors.

makePath.desc: Searches for a random path in the graph, by depth-first search with backtracking. Uses the start/finish nodes (rectangle flags, otherwise the nodes closest to params.start/finish). In closed circuit mode, picks a neighbor of the start that does not cut the graph.

returns.desc: List of path nodes, or nil if no path found

currentEdgeNotOK.desc: Tests whether adding the next edge from the current node is forbidden.

returns.desc: true if the edge is not allowed

edgeCreatesSplitGraph.desc: Tests whether adding nextNode to the path would split the remaining graph into unconnected parts.

returns.desc: true if the graph would be split

isInList.desc: Tests whether an element is present in a list.

createWindingPath.desc: Extracts layout information (angles, distances, normals) from the path, determines the radii and node types (straight, curve, loop, gate) then computes the road points.

getBaseInformationFromPath.desc: Extracts basic information from the path: angles, distances, normals, etc.

determineInOutAngle.desc: Determines the entry and exit angles around the circles (turns).

getPathRoadNodes.desc: Computes all the points needed to create the road around the nodes.

createWindingRoad.desc: Creates the road's DecalRoad objects (materials tread_marks_clean and road_orange_markings) in the GymkhanaArena group.

decorateStartAndFinish.desc: Decorates the start and finish nodes.

createPylons.desc: Creates the cones, gates and concrete rings at the nodes (circle or central cone depending on the radius, gate for a straight line or a zero radius).

createWaypointsForScenario.desc: Creates the positions and angles of the waypoints (directional BeamNGWaypoint objects) and fills scenario.nodes / scenario.lapConfig of the current scenario.

dist.desc: 2D Euclidean distance from point (a, b) to point (x, y).

makePylon.desc: Creates a cone (TSStatic barriersegment from the driver_training level) at a local position of the course.

size.desc: Scale: number (height, width 0.33) or {x, y, z} (default {0.33, 0.33, 1})

makeGate.desc: Creates a gate (TSStatic gate.dae) at a local position.

makeConcreteRing.desc: Creates a concrete ring (TSStatic ring_2m.dae) of the given radius (minimum 1).

makeBarrel.desc: Creates a signaling barrel (TSStatic barrelmarker_<skin>.dae), rotated by 180 degrees in addition to rot.

getRotationDeg.desc: Converts a local angle (degrees) to a global angle by removing the course root's rotation.

getPosition.desc: Transforms a local position of the course into a global position (rotation by rootAngleRad then offset by rootX, rootY, rootZ).

getSeed.desc: Returns the seed of the current track.

returns.desc: Seed, or nil if no track generated

wordsToInt.desc: Converts a sequence of 5-letter words (seed expressed as words) to an integer.

intToWords.desc: Converts an integer seed to a sequence of concatenated 5-letter words (base of the word list size).
